description: This content is sent to the headlesson operator. Feedback about headlesson itself is sufficient. Do not include personal information or conversation contents.

about.description: Optional record ID that the feedback concerns; feedback about headlesson itself needs no product ID.

client.description: Optional client name only; do not include full User-Agent, account IDs or credentials.

kind.description: Report type: comment, worked, failed, missing or tip; receipt does not verify the claim.

model.description: Optional model name associated with the report, without conversation content.

text.description: Feedback to the headlesson operator, 1–2000 Unicode characters; exclude personal information and conversation text.
examples: The lesson needs a clearer owner-login prerequisite.

name: headlesson_feedback
title: Send feedback to headlesson
